DE-5 FLAKE ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED (vc-debugger, 2010s, evidence-before-hypothesis). NOT a state-bleed flake - every candidate in the brief was ruled out by captured evidence (advisory_locks=0 so no leaked lock and no skipped_locked branch; flag_at_return=True so no flag bleed; ledger had the correctly-seeded ACCRUE row so schema at head and no DE-13 freeze leak - DE-13 runs AFTER DE-5 anyway; no coop_expiry_sweep_crashed so no swallowed cross-event-loop exception). REAL MECHANISM = submit-vs-complete race, two APScheduler 3.11.2 facts combined: (1) BaseScheduler._process_jobs calls executor.submit_job at base.py:1195 then advances next_run_time at :1228-1229, so next_run_time moves at SUBMIT not completion and _run_job_now exit predicate fires while the coroutine still runs; (2) AsyncIOExecutor.shutdown() carries the upstream comment "There is no way to honor wait=True without converting this method into a coroutine method" and cancels every pending future, while apps/api/jobs/scheduler.py:954 calls shutdown(wait=False) and main.py:114 calls it from the lifespan. Chain: _run_job_now returns at submit -> lifespan exits -> stop_scheduler -> shutdown(wait=False) -> executor cancels the in-flight _coop_expiry_sweep_job -> CancelledError BEFORE the per-lot commit -> no EXPIRE row -> assert 0 == 1. MEASURED: full file unmodified 2/30 (6.7pc), instrumented 6/40 (15pc), DE-5 alone 0/20, post-fix 0/40, fix mutated back out 2/20 (10pc). pytest-randomly NOT installed so collection order was already fixed - the file-order dependence is a TIMING effect not a state effect: DE-3/DE-4 shift sweep-duration median 111ms -> 134ms with a fatter tail crossing the fixed 250ms poll deadline. Sweep duration n=33 passing min 58 median 134 max 250 vs a 250ms tick. Near-miss run d13 PROVES the window precisely: sweep CANCELLED yet the row SURVIVED (rows_after_exit=1) because expire_lapsed_lots commits per-lot and cancellation landed after the commit during the finally rollback/unlock - so the red window is narrower still, cancelled-BEFORE-the-per-lot-commit. FIX: _run_job_now attaches an APScheduler listener BEFORE job.modify (a listener attached after would miss the event and hang) and awaits EVENT_JOB_EXECUTED|EVENT_JOB_ERROR|EVENT_JOB_MISSED, dispatched from the future done-callback so it cannot be observed early. NO retry, NO sleep, NO flaky marker - the deadline is DELETED not lengthened; rationale + both source citations + the measured numbers are in the function docstring so it cannot be re-derived. FALSIFIABILITY PRESERVED, both mutations reverted byte-exact sha256 5b91393c..6ebb: Mutation A (seed expires_at in the FUTURE so the sweep legitimately writes nothing) -> DE-5 RED, proving the assertion still carries signal and _run_job_now is not returning vacuously; Mutation B (swap the event wait back for asyncio.sleep(0.25)) -> 2/20 red, reproducing the original rate, proving the wait is load-bearing.
